description: Use this skill when the user asks for a code review against NASA/DOD-grade engineering standards. Triggers include "nasa-dod review", "nasa-dod dev review", "nasa-dod pr review", or any request to review code against flight-software, defense-system, or mission-critical engineering standards. Runs in two modes — full codebase scan during development, diff-first during PR review — and gates merges on critical (P0) findings, with three concrete fix options per issue.
